newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Current Australian Takeovers (F to O)-Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Current Australian Takeovers (F to O)-Sept 30.

text.p: NOTES: ANZ Securities is standing in the market for a

period of a month from August 21. Offeror is now entitled to 95.33 percent and said on September 20 it would not proceed to compulsory acquisition. Directors recommend shareholders accept the offer in the absence of a higher offer.
OFFEROR: Suncorp Insurance and Finance, the Queensland Industry Development Corp.
TERMS: The proposed merger values Metway at A$4.65
ex-dividend. Bid was raised to A$4.80 per share on June 26.
NOTES: The offer is through a scheme of arrangement and
was subject to court, shareholder and regulatory approval.
TERMS: A$2.64 cash per share and one cent per option
NOTES: Offeror is currently entitled to 99.06 percent
of the issued capital of the offeree and 78.14 percent of the issued option capital.
TERMS: Normandy to offer 425 of its shares for every
NOTES: North Flinders is about 50 percent owned by

Posgold Ltd, which is currently subject to a merger proposal by Normandy. Offer is conditional on successful completion of the proposed Normandy/Posgold/Gold Mine of Kalgoorlie merger which was approved by shareholders on August 16. Offeror is entitled to 72.79 percent of North Flinders' capital. Directors recommended shareholders accept the bid. Court approval for the scheme of arrangement was received on August 22.
NOTES: Directors advise shareholders to reject the
offer, following an independent report that valued its shares between A$1.92 and A$2.14. Offeror is entitled to 20.43 percent of the offeree.
